tier_definition.easy: observed at least two fires and the first fire was by turn 3
tier_definition.moderate: observed at least one fire but did not satisfy easy
tier_definition.near_miss: observed no fire but reached within one state point of a condition
tier_definition.not_observed: observed no fire and never came within one state point
tier_definition.warning: Diagnostic bands only: they are not a Gate threshold and do not prove causal controllability by the tested model.
